card.summary: The fee page grants real-name verified accounts 480 CPU core-hours plus 960 GiB-hours of free Agent Sandbox use on first access, valid 30 days and claimable ...

free_tier.stated: The fee page grants real-name verified accounts 480 CPU core-hours plus 960 GiB-hours of free Agent Sandbox use on first access, valid 30 days and claimable once per account (one 2C4G sandbox for 10 days or twenty 2C4G sandboxes for 12 hours), with vCPU billed by the second thereafter and the first 10 GB of local storage free.

egress.terms: Every sandbox has outbound internet access by default and the platform controls it with allow and deny lists; the fee page bills vCPU, memory, local and persistent storage and publishes no per-GB outbound price.

record.interface_detail: Python SDK (`pip install ucloud-sandbox`), a CLI, an E2B-compatible SDK and a REST API are documented; authentication uses the UCLOUD_SANDBOX_API_KEY environment variable.

limits.value: a sandbox can be paused and resumed with its full running state preserved
a Volume is independent of a sandbox and can mount into several, in beta

The fee page bills vCPU and memory by the second and grants the first 10 GB of local storage free with a 60 GB persistent-storage allowance; the quota page caps CPU at 8 cores, memory at 8 GB, 20 concurrent sandboxes and 10 GB of storage per user.

identity_cost.detail: The free grant requires a real-name verified account; the SDK authenticates with an API key from the key-management page.

record.confidence_note: the documentation index was read on 2026-10-22 (Chinese) and states the pause-and-resume state model, the beta Volume and the E2B compatibility. The billing and quota pages it links were not read, so no figure is asserted
